$comment: Controlled variables for the OMA A/B benchmark. Every field here is written into bench/REPORT.md verbatim. Do not change values between the pilot and the full run without re-running the pilot.

judge.$comment: Same vendor as the models under test. Accepted here because both candidates in every pair come from that same vendor, so vendor self-preference applies symmetrically; position bias is handled by scoring each pair in both orders. REPORT.md must state this.

pricing.$comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, PEAK rates from https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing (verified 2026-08-18). DeepSeek charges peak rates 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC and half that off-peak; the whole benchmark invocation must sit inside one window for these numbers to be exact, and REPORT.md records the window actually used.
